hero.title: Every ride deserves good chai.
hero.text: Bold tea, warm spices and the comfort of a roadside chai break—served with a clean, contemporary CHAI RIDES touch in Siddipet, Telangana.

beans.title: Tea, spice and milk in balance
beans.text: From robust Assam tea to ginger, cardamom and house spice, each ingredient is chosen to make every cup fragrant, full-bodied and comforting.

steps.title: Select
steps.text: Begin with bold tea leaves and clean, aromatic spices.

steps.title: Crush
steps.text: Ginger and spices are prepared to release their brightest aroma.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Tea, milk and spice come together slowly for depth and body.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Every chai is finished fresh and served at its best.

menu.title: Pick your pour and watch it come alive
menu.note: Choose a classic cup, a warming spice blend or a chilled chai. Ask the team about milk options.

bakery.title: Something savoury on the side
bakery.text: Familiar Indian café favourites chosen to sit naturally beside a hot cup of chai.
